candidate.title: MES Parabolic SAR stop-and-reverse trend [ideas:harvest-classic-parabolic-sar-trail]
candidate.one_line: From Ideas `harvest-classic-parabolic-sar-trail`. Go long when close crosses above SAR and short when below; always reverse; 3 ATR stop backstop. Source: J. Welles Wilder (1978), New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems (Parabolic SAR).

sources.title: Ideas registry: Parabolic SAR flip system
sources.creator: Ideas feeder (OVH)
sources.claim: Long while SAR dots below price; flip short when SAR flips above (and vice versa). AF start 0.02, step 0.02, max 0.20 (Wilder defaults). Pure mechanical trail/flip.
